The quiet return of the canal lock-keeper

By Bertil Achterberg

For forty years the locks on the Fenwater canal were worked by whoever happened to be on the boat. This spring, for the first time since the old cottages were sold, three of them have a keeper again.

The canal trust says the keepers are there to help a new generation of hire-boat crews who have never worked a paddle, and to keep an eye on gates that are older than anyone who uses them.
